title: fix(app-shell): the flow designer and Debug run stop offering and emulating the single-brace dialect (objectui#12329)
body:
Fixes #12329
Clause-②: no

Studio's flow designer and Debug run stop offering and emulating the single-brace `{var}` dialect. objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 S7 (`7958bdf36d`, shipped in `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1`, which `main` installs) deleted the engine's single-brace resolver. A value slot refuses a `{…}` token, a text slot reads `{{ }}` holes, and every other flow string is a literal. This PR reuses the mechanisms of PR #12371 and PR #12379: the bare-reference picker, the `{{ }}` hole mode (`refMode: 'hole'`), the ledger's literal / CEL-envelope value-slot control, and the spec's own refusals. It adds no mode. The single-brace spelling is removed from the picker.

## Measured first: what next.1 says at each position

Instrument: `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, `flowNodeConfigRefusals` and `resolveFlowNodeValueSlots` from the installed `@objectstack/spec/automation` (`18.0.0-next.1`), plus a read of the engine's executors at the `18.0.0-next.1` tag commit `0c52e43075` (`logic-nodes.ts` and `loop-node.ts` in `service-automation`). The engine files were read, not run.

| Position | next.1 judge | `{x}` | Engine at next.1 | Here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| assignment map `assignments.*` | value slot | refused | refuses before any write; envelope evaluated; literal `copyLiteral` | simulator refuses with the spec's text |
| assignment legacy array `[{ variable, value }]` | template judge | refused | same refusal, then literal | simulator refuses |
| assignment bare config `{ var: value }` | template judge | refused, at any depth | same refusal, then literal | simulator refuses |
| loop `collection`, with `body` | value slot + loop contract | refused; a bare name refused by the contract | envelope evaluated, inline array iterated, not a list fails the node | simulator mirrors all four |
| loop `collection`, no `body` (legacy) | no door judges it | accepted | `variables.get(collection)`, the string as written | designer: bare-name picker and brace check. Simulator: reads the name as written, so `{leadList}` binds nothing |
| map `collection` | value slot | refused | (PR #12379) | unchanged |
| connector `input.*`, legacy action `params` | none | accepted, a literal | nothing reads a token | text cell: no picker |
| any other text field (output / item variable names, notify `topic`, …) | none | literal | nothing reads a token | no picker |

The served descriptors on next.1 publish `xExpression: 'expression'` and `'value'` only. `'template'` appears only in a doc comment.

## What changed

- **`VariableTextInput`**: `VariableFieldMode` is `'expression' | 'hole'`. `formatToken` has no single-brace spelling, and `mode` defaults to `'expression'`. A literal position passes no `groups`, so it renders no picker (the mechanism PR #12371 used for a value-role text cell).
- **`FlowNodeConfigField`**: a `text` / `textarea` field with no `refMode` is a literal: no picker and no reference note. An `expression` field still marked `refMode: 'template'`, which is only the body-less loop's `collection` (the value-slot control takes every other), renders like an expression field. Its picker inserts the bare name, and a stored `{leadList}` gets the brace check, whose fix is `leadList`. The value-slot control's text cell no longer passes a template mode.
- **`FlowKeyValueField`**: a text cell is a literal unless the map is a `{{ }}` text-slot map (`valueMode: 'hole'`). It has no picker and no single-brace reference note.
- **`FlowExprIssue`**: its role is `FlowExprIssueRole` (`predicate` / `value` / `hole`). The single-brace role it rendered nothing for is gone.
- **`json-schema-to-fields`**: `exprModeOf` reads `'expression'` only. A `'template'` mark (no longer published) or a `'value'` mark degrades to a plain text field. The ledger renders the value slots.
- **`flow-simulator.ts`**: `interpolateValue`, `interpolateString`, `resolveToken`, `resolveRef` and their helpers are removed. Assignment: `flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals('assignment', config)` refuses before any write, in all three shapes. Otherwise a map envelope is evaluated by the existing `evalValueEnvelope` (the runtime's `@objectstack/formula` engine and scope), and every other value is a `copyLiteral` copy. Loop with a body: the two config judges, then an envelope evaluated or an inline array used as written, with not-a-list as an error. Loop without a body: the name is read as written. objectui already had a CEL evaluator, so no new dependency was added.
- **Prose**: the `refMode` doc, the `conditionBuilder` doc, the decision help ("bare references, no braces"), the end `message` quote of the spec's current wording, and the screen-preview and recipients comments.
- **i18n** (en and zh): `engine.flowSim.note.unmodelled` and `engine.flowSim.note.unmodelledToken` are removed, because no token is kept as written any more. `engine.flowSim.note.loopCollectionNotList` is added.

## Pins

- `inspectors/flowSingleBrace-12329.test.tsx`:
  - Every offline text-like field of every node type is rendered on its node. Where it offers a picker, picking writes no single-brace token.
  - Six named literal fields have no picker. Control: a text slot and an expression field keep theirs.
  - Body-less loop collection: the picker inserts `customer`, and `{leadList}` is flagged with `` `leadList` ``.
  - connector `input` text cell: no picker. Control: http `headers` keeps its hole picker.
  - No help or placeholder of any offline field, en or zh, carries a single-brace token. The pattern pins itself against `{{ x }}`, `{"$ne": null}`, `{ "key": "value" }` and `defineStack({ functions })`.
- `previews/simulator/__tests__/flow-simulator.singleBrace-12329.test.ts`, one pin per position:
  - the legacy assignment array and the bare config refuse `{token}` with the spec's refusal;
  - loop with a body: envelope, inline array, `{leadList}` refused, bare name refused by the contract, not-a-list, and a CEL fault;
  - loop without a body: a bare name binds, and `{leadList}` binds nothing.
- `flow-simulator.guardsInterpolation-10615.test.ts`: the assignment-map block is now five refusal rows (nested object, array element, whole token, dotted token, `{NOW()}`). Each expects the spec's message and path, and that no variable was written. A key spelling a token is not judged, and a token-free value is a copy.
- Updated:
  - pins that asserted the dialect: `VariableTextInput.test.ts`, `FlowNodeConfigField.test.tsx`, `json-schema-to-fields.test.ts`, `flowTextSlots.doubleBrace-11824`, `flowValueSlots-12372`, `flow-simulator.parity-10692` (its unmodelled-token block), `flow-simulator.test.ts`, `flow-simulator.valueEnvelope-10537`, and the `previewStrings.i18n-10835` Debug-run sweep, which now covers `loopCollection` and `loopCollectionNotList`;
  - fixtures and comments that authored the dialect: `FlowNodeInspector.connectorOutputRefs-11028`, `FlowNodeConfigField.entryCondition`, `flow-node-config.test.ts`.

**Ablation**, with the fix committed at `7b09dc67c`:

- Mutation: the eight implementation files were checked out from the base `0a63422ec`. `VariableTextInput.tsx`, `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`, `FlowKeyValueField.tsx`, `json-schema-to-fields.ts`, `flow-node-config.ts`, `FlowExprIssue.tsx`, `flow-simulator.ts` and `i18n.ts` were reverted, with the tests kept at HEAD. On-disk proof: the single-brace `formatToken` arm count is 1, `interpolateString` count is 4, and `isLiteral` / `configRefusal` counts are 0.
- Result over six pin files: `Test Files 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`, `Tests 45 failed | 93 passed (138)`.
  - `flowSingleBrace-12329`: 27 of 48 failed.
  - `flow-simulator.singleBrace-12329`: 9 of 11.
  - `guardsInterpolation-10615`: 5 of 31.
  - `FlowNodeConfigField.test`: 2 of 7.
  - `json-schema-to-fields`: 2 of 33.
  - `VariableTextInput.test.ts` stays green at run time. Its narrowing is held by the test type-check, which refused the old `'template'` calls before this PR updated them.
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` on the eight absolute paths, inside a trap. `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes, and every file's hash equals its `HEAD` blob.

## Verification

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) at `7b09dc67c`: VERDICT command-exit 0 for both.
- 102 targeted files: every flow inspector, simulator, json-schema-to-fields, flow preview and `previewStrings` test. Each red file was then re-run green after its update.
- The full app-shell project (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`) at `7b09dc67c`: `Test Files 1342 passed | 1 skipped (1343)`, `Tests 12987 passed | 9 skipped (12996)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. This includes the Problems-panel and node-rename suites (`flow-expr-problems`, `flow-node-refs.*`), unchanged.
- At the final head `a5e09017c`, which adds one comment line in `FlowRecipientsField.tsx` over `7b09dc67c`:
  - all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `new-line-citations`, `control-bytes`, `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `test-path-roots`, plus `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `FlowRecipientsField*` tests: 17 passed.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec …"). That is objectui#12334 on main. This diff touches no `package.json`.
- eslint, narrowed to the 25 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 0 errors and 18 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch:
  - `react-refresh/only-export-components` on already-exported helpers;
  - `no-explicit-any` and two `react-hooks` rules in `FlowNodeInspector.tsx`;
  - the recipients file's eight.
  `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions` project, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Remaining hits of `{leadList}` / `{items}` / `interpolat` / `{record` in inspector and simulator sources:
  - four comments name `{record.x}` as the brace-in-CEL mistake being flagged;
  - two `FlowRecipientsField` comments name a stored `{record.owner}` as refused;
  - `flow-value-envelope.ts` says what spec 17 did.
  None offers or prescribes the token. The i18n hits are `tFormat` placeholders (`{items}`, `{recordId}`) and the action URL hint (`${param.x}`), not flow tokens.

## Acceptance notes

- **The analysis passes are not touched.** They sit outside the dispatched file surface. `previews/flow-expr-problems.ts` still skips an expression field marked `refMode: 'template'` and its header says such a value uses single braces legally. `previews/flow-node-refs.ts` still reads that mark, and every config string the ledger does not list, as a single-brace template when it renames a node. For example, it rewrites `{x.items}` to `{renamed.items}` in a loop collection. That is why the loop / map `collection` descriptors keep `refMode: 'template'`: the inspector no longer reads it as a picker spelling, and those two passes still read it. Retiring the mark is the analysis-pass half.
- **Online vs offline body-less loop.** Served, the loop descriptor's `collection` carries `xExpression: 'value'`, which maps to a plain text field. A body-less loop online therefore shows a literal box with no picker, while offline it shows the bare-name expression field. Neither offers a single-brace token.
- **The simulator's body-less loop binds `iteratorVariable` to the first item.** The legacy executor binds `$loopItems` / `$loopIndex` instead. That modelling predates this change and is kept.
- A stored `{token}` is not rewritten automatically, as in PR #12371 and PR #12379.

Changeset: `.changeset/12329-flow-single-brace-s7.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, minor). Clause-②: no published `@object-ui/*` export moves. None of the changed modules is re-exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`.
